How Disney Destiny's Pumpkin Tree Comes to Life 🎃
Step behind the scenes with Disney Live Entertainment as our team programs and rehearses with Solara, the Enchanted Pumpkin Tree appearing aboard the Disney Destiny during its first Halloween on the High Seas celebration. 🎃

From early programming to onboard rehearsals, here's a look at how this Halloween character comes to life at sea.
